text:
marta: Quick question for the group — I sketched a small proposal to reduce duplication across hosted/dedicated/private: keep a tiny common core API (request/response envelope + observability hooks) and define mode-specific extension points for routing, credential binding, and tenancy. Thoughts?

kai: +1 to a small core. we keep semantics consistent for application code. biggest risk is hidden mode assumptions in adapters.

devon: what about secrets / KMS differences? private needs customer KMS/HSM, hosted uses our KMS. we can't leak that into the core, but adapters should expose a uniform secret-ref type.

marta: exact — core should only reference an abstract SecretRef string e.g. "kms://proj/foo" and adapters map to actual KMS calls. that keeps client-facing contracts the same.

sam: operationally we also need a clear telemetry contract. mode extensions should tag traces with `hosting.mode` and a normalized `tenant_id` field. otherwise dashboards are a mess.

lee: +1. also propose a capability vector on the manifest so we can do graceful fallbacks: `capabilities: ["streaming", "kv_cache", "quantized_8bit"]` — runtime uses that to pick compatible variants.

marta: here's a tiny example manifest for the core + extension idea:

```json
{
  "core": {
    "input_schema": "text",
    "outputs": ["tokens"]
  },
  "extensions": {
    "routing": {"policy": "latency_or_cost"},
    "secrets": {"ref_type": "kms"},
    "capabilities": ["streaming","kv_cache"]
  }
}
```

kai: looks good. migration path? we need an automated shim so older adapters can advertise a capability mask. propose an `adapter_compat_level` header: v1 (legacy), v2 (core+ext).

devon: timeframe: rolling this out in Dedicated/Private first seems safer. Hosted can opt-in later once adapters expose the capability vector. plan: dedicated canary -> private canary -> hosted opt-in.

sam: ops-bot: note that we should add conformance tests (unit + integration) — adapter must pass `capabilities/behavior` suite before we allow traffic. ops-bot: also add an alert if an adapter reports capability mismatch at runtime.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-7843 to add adapter conformance suite and runtime mismatch alerting. ETA: 3 sprints.

lee: edgecase: what if private runtime doesn't support streaming due to infra constraints? fallback should result in a clear error code (e.g., 412) and a structured hint: "fallback": "use_polling_variant". apps can surface a user-friendly message.

marta: good call. we'll standardize a small set of fallback codes and hints in the core contract.

kai: perf tradeoffs: core should allow latency SLO hints so adapters can pick faster kernels or quantized variants. suggest `desired_slo_ms` field in request metadata.

devon: security note: adapters must never materialize customer plaintext keys in hosted control plane logs — express that as a contract clause.

sam: next steps: marta to put RFC draft with manifest schema + migration checklist. kai/devon to draft adapter shim spec. i'll add telemetry fields to the tracing spec. ops-bot will schedule conformance work.

marta: I'll drop the RFC to the `architecture` RFC board by EOD tomorrow. ping me if I missed anything. :arrow_down:
